Notes.Text:
This update for netcdf fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-86095: out-of-bounds write in `NC4_HDF5_inq_attname()` due to missing length validation when processing a
  crafted HDF5 file (bsc#1279882).

Vulnerabilities.Description: Unidata netcdf-c through 4.10.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in NC4_HDF5_inq_attname() that copies HDF5 attribute names into a fixed 256-byte buffer without length validation. Attackers can craft HDF5 files with oversized attribute names to overflow the destination buffer, causing memory corruption and crashes when applications enumerate attribute names.
